/* 연도학기만목록조회 */
SELECT DISTINCT SC.DGRS_YR , SC.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT , SC.SMSTR_CHRT_GBNCD , CASE WHEN NVL(SC.SMSTR_CHRT_GBNCD, 'SMSTR') = 'SMSTR' THEN SC.DGRS_YR || '년도 ' || SC.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT || '학기' ELSE SC.DGRS_YR || '년도 ' || SC.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT || '기' END AS YR_SMSTRNM FROM TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY DGRS_YR DESC, DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT DESC, YR_SMSTRNM DESC
